hooks.name: new-file-review
hooks.description: When a new component, layout or page is created, check it against the foundation before moving on.

action.prompt: A new Astro file was just created. Before continuing, confirm it follows the foundation: pages render inside FoundationLayout and are built from <Section> and existing components; styles live in src/styles/<area>/*.css and use tokens only; behavior lives in src/scripts/ and is imported from a <script> tag; every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion path; images have width and height. Fix anything that does not, then run `node scripts/design-lint.mjs <file>`.
